title: reconcileTime
body:
## reconcileTime

Compare the capture clocks of photographs without writing anything: photos are grouped by the device that recorded them (or by your declaration), each group gets a skew (recorded minus true, in exact seconds) from the true times you declare for named photos, constant or linear-drift, and the report lists the capture time every photo would have if corrected, simultaneous-shot consistency and GPS time stamp cross-checks.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- A true time is your declaration: a reference, an assumed offset or an assumeCorrect group is published as declared and never verified, so a tidy report is not proof that any clock was right.
- Skew is estimated only from references you list; nothing is inferred from file times, GPS stamps or other photos, and a group without a reference is reported as having insufficient evidence rather than guessed.
- No time zone, daylight-saving rule or leap second is known: a UTC instant exists only where the same file records an offset or you assumed one, and the report labels which.
- Two bodies of one model without serial numbers are indistinguishable by recorded identity; group them by declaration instead.
- A skew belongs to an instant: an item with no recorded or assumed offset gets no skew from a drift model, and a group anchored through simultaneity is reported conflicting when its own references contradict the path.

Native binding: `the same fixed native listing, used to anchor the independent reader of every time source; the clock model (device groups, reference skew, drift, simultaneity) is exact host arithmetic over typed records, with no native time arithmetic`. Output kind: `["text","table"]`.

Inputs: none.

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `media` | The set of photographs and XMP sidecar files to read: either an explicit list of items or one folder. Every item is captured into the run before any native process starts, and every scanned folder entry is listed in manifest.json as included or excluded with a reason, so you can see exactly which files were and were not examined. | `{"type":"union","options":[{"type":"object","properties":{"items":{"type":"array","required":true,"minItems":1,"maxItems":512,"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"path":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":4096,"required":true},"sha256":{"type":"string","minLength":64,"maxLength":64},"sidecar":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":4096}}}}}},{"type":"object","properties":{"folder":{"type":"object","required":true,"properties":{"path":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":4096,"required":true},"extensions":{"type":"array","minItems":1,"maxItems":11,"uniqueItems":true,"items":{"type":"enum","values":[".jpg",".jpeg",".xmp",".tif",".tiff",".dng",".png",".webp",".heic",".heif",".avif"]}},"depth":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":2},"maxItems":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":512},"sidecars":{"type":"enum","values":["none","adjacent"]}}}}}]}` | **required** |
| `groups` | How photos are grouped into camera clocks. By default photos are grouped by the exact recorded make, model and body serial text; declare members to group by your own names instead (for example two bodies of one model). A group is the unit that receives one skew or one correction. | `{"type":"object","properties":{"by":{"type":"enum","values":["recordedDevice","declared"],"required":true},"keys":{"type":"array","minItems":1,"maxItems":3,"uniqueItems":true,"items":{"type":"enum","values":["cameraMake","cameraModel","bodySerialNumber"]}},"members":{"type":"array","minItems":1,"maxItems":64,"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"group":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"items":{"type":"array","required":true,"minItems":1,"maxItems":512,"items":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32}}}}},"itemOverrides":{"type":"array","minItems":1,"maxItems":256,"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"item":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"group":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true}}}}}}` | omitted |
| `references` | True times you declare for named photos: the reference from which a group skew is derived. They are declarations and are never verified. | `{"type":"array","minItems":1,"maxItems":256,"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"item":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"trueLocal":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32},"trueOffset":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":8},"trueUtc":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32},"note":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":200}}}}` | omitted |
| `simultaneous` | Sets of photos you assert were taken at the same moment by different cameras. They check the clock model: a group whose references disagree with a simultaneity assertion is reported as conflicting, not averaged. | `{"type":"array","minItems":1,"maxItems":256,"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"items":{"type":"array","required":true,"minItems":2,"maxItems":16,"items":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32}},"toleranceSeconds":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":24}}}}` | omitted |
| `assumeCorrect` | Groups whose clock you declare is correct: their skew is taken as zero without a reference. This is a declaration, not a verification, and it is refused if a reference or residual contradicts it. | `{"type":"array","minItems":1,"maxItems":64,"uniqueItems":true,"items":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32}}` | omitted |
| `assumedOffsets` | The UTC offset to assume for groups whose files record no offset (or whose recorded offset you do not trust). The instant derived from an assumed offset is labelled assumed; a recorded but unreadable or conflicting offset is not treated as absent. | `{"type":"array","minItems":1,"maxItems":64,"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"group":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"offset":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":8,"required":true}}}}` | omitted |
| `model` | constant treats each group clock as a fixed offset from true time; linearDrift lets the skew grow linearly between references, bounded by maxDriftRate and maxDriftExtrapolationSeconds. | `{"type":"enum","values":["constant","linearDrift"]}` | omitted |
| `toleranceSeconds` | How much references of one group may disagree (residual after the fitted skew), in seconds, before the group is reported as conflicting. | `{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":24}` | omitted |
| `maxDriftRate` | The largest drift rate the linearDrift model accepts, in seconds of skew per second (above 0, at most 0.01). | `{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":24}` | omitted |
| `maxDriftExtrapolationSeconds` | How far outside the span of its references a group's drift may be extended, in seconds (0 to 86400). Outside it the item is reported, not silently extrapolated. | `{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":86400}` | omitted |
| `gpsToleranceSeconds` | The largest difference between the GPS UTC stamp and the capture instant that timePlausibility accepts without a finding. Meaningful only with that rule. | `{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":86400}` | omitted |
